options.content:
The **Giant Swarm Agent Platform** runs AI agents on your own infrastructure and gives them governed access to curated tools.

This board is the entry point: is the platform healthy, and what is it doing. Every health panel reads the same series as the alert that pages for it, so a panel and a page cannot disagree.

| Board | What it covers |
|---|---|
| **LLM usage** | tokens, cost and latency per agent and per model |
| **Usage by person** | the same, per signed-in person |
| **Agentgateway** | the gateway itself: requests, MCP tool calls, control-plane config distribution, runtime |
| **Muster / MCP Gateway** | the MCP server fleet, tool calls and workflows |
| **Klaus Gateway** | the channel front door: requests, turns and their phases, Slack streaming |
| **Valkey** | the platform's key-value stores: memory against the limit, evictions, traffic |
| **mcp-kubernetes** (administrator, security, cluster operator) | the Kubernetes MCP server, where that component is on |

Postgres has no board of its own: its row is below. The full CloudNativePG board lives in the Giant Swarm organization, for Giant Swarm staff.

panels.description: Platform HelmReleases that have not been Ready. AgentPlatformHelmReleaseNotReady pages after an hour on the same series.

targets.expr: count(gotk_resource_info{job="flux-ksm", ready="False", customresource_kind="HelmRelease", cluster_type="management_cluster", exported_namespace="flux-giantswarm", team="bumblebee", cluster_id=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: HelmReleases not ready

panels.description: Available replicas of the kagent control plane. KagentControllerDown pages after 30 minutes at zero; agents on the installation are down.
panels.title: kagent-controller replicas

panels.description: MCP servers muster cannot reach. MusterMCPServerFailed notifies after 20 minutes.

targets.expr: count(max by (mcpserver_name, mcpserver_namespace) (muster_mcpserver_state{state="Failed", cluster_type="management_cluster", cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: MCP servers failed

panels.description: MCP servers muster has a live session with.

targets.expr: count(max by (mcpserver_name, mcpserver_namespace) (muster_mcpserver_state{state="Connected", cluster_type="management_cluster", cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: MCP servers connected

panels.description: CloudNativePG clusters of the platform outside a healthy phase. AgentPlatformPostgresClusterNotHealthy pages after 30 minutes.

targets.expr: count(kube_cnpg_cluster_info{cluster_type="management_cluster", namespace=~"agent-platform|kagent", phase!="Cluster in healthy state", cluster_id=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Postgres clusters unhealthy

panels.description: Platform containers with more than five restarts in the last hour. AgentPlatformContainerRestartingTooOften pages after 15 minutes.

targets.expr: count(sum by (namespace, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster_type="management_cluster", namespace=~"agent-platform|kagent|mcp-kubernetes|mcp-capi|mcp-prometheus", cluster_id=~"$cluster"}[1h])) > 5) or vector(0)

panels.title: Containers restarting

panels.description: 1 means muster keeps OAuth sessions in memory, so every restart signs every person out. AgentPlatformMusterSessionStoresInMemory pages in working hours.
panels.title: muster session store

panels.description: Share of the Valkey memory limit in use. AgentPlatformValkeyMemoryHigh notifies above 90%.
panels.title: Valkey memory used

panels.description: One line per platform HelmRelease: 1 while it is Ready.

targets.expr: max by (name) (gotk_resource_info{job="flux-ksm", ready="True", customresource_kind="HelmRelease", cluster_type="management_cluster", exported_namespace="flux-giantswarm", team="bumblebee", cluster_id=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: HelmRelease readiness by release

panels.description: Restarts in the last hour per container, over the platform's namespaces.
panels.title: Container restarts per hour

panels.description: Every token the gateway proxied for an agent, all models and token types. LLM usage breaks it down.
panels.title: Tokens / s

panels.description: Estimated spend at the current rate. A model with no price in the catalog reads as zero, not as an error; the Price catalog row of LLM usage names them.
panels.title: Cost / hour

panels.description: MCP tool calls through the gateway. The Agentgateway board breaks them down by tool.
panels.title: Tool calls / s

panels.description: Distinct agents that called a model in the window.
panels.title: Agents calling

panels.description: Share of gateway responses that were not 2xx, every listener.
panels.title: Gateway error ratio

panels.description: MCP servers muster knows, whatever their state.

targets.expr: count(max by (mcpserver_name, mcpserver_namespace) (muster_mcpserver_state{cluster_type="management_cluster", cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: MCP servers

panels.description: Which agents are spending. LLM usage has the cost and the models.
panels.title: Tokens per second by agent

panels.description: Which tool backends the agents are using, from muster's dispatch metrics.
panels.title: Tool calls per second by MCP server

panels.description: 1 while the CloudNativePG cluster is in a healthy phase. The same series AgentPlatformPostgresClusterNotHealthy reads.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, name) (kube_cnpg_cluster_info{cluster_type="management_cluster", namespace=~"agent-platform|kagent", phase="Cluster in healthy state", cluster_id=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Cluster phase

panels.description: Connections waiting on a lock. Sustained growth is a query or a migration holding one.
panels.title: Backends waiting

panels.description: Seconds between the last archived and the last failed WAL archive. Above zero means archiving is failing, so point-in-time recovery is not available.
panels.title: WAL archive lag

panels.description: muster keeps its OAuth sessions here. At the limit Valkey evicts, and an evicted session signs a person out.

targets.expr: max by (namespace) (redis_memory_used_bytes{cluster_type="management_cluster", namespace=~"agent-platform|kagent|mcp-kubernetes|mcp-capi|mcp-prometheus", cluster_id=~"$cluster"}) / max by (namespace) (redis_memory_max_bytes{cluster_type="management_cluster", namespace=~"agent-platform|kagent|mcp-kubernetes|mcp-capi|mcp-prometheus", cluster_id=~"$cluster"} > 0)

panels.title: Memory used against the limit

panels.description: Clients holding a connection to Valkey.
panels.title: Connected clients

panels.description: Above zero means Valkey is dropping data to stay inside its limit, and a dropped session signs a person out.
panels.title: Keys evicted per second
